name: Google Business Profile
notes: Highest impact for local map searches. Verify address, add 10+ photos, collect reviews weekly.

name: Bing Places for Business
notes: Import from Google Business Profile after GBP is live to save time.

name: Apple Business Connect
notes: Shows your business on Apple Maps and Siri on iPhones.

name: Facebook Business Page
notes: Add website, WhatsApp button, service areas, and weekly project photos.

name: Instagram Business
notes: Link to website in bio. Post before/after workshop jobs with location tags (Sharjah, Ajman).

name: LinkedIn Company Page
notes: Good for B2B garage owners and fleet workshops.

name: Yellow Pages UAE
notes: Search the site first; if not listed, use Contact / Add business options on their site.

name: Dubizzle (Business / Services)
notes: Post service ads in Motors / Services with link to your website and WhatsApp.

name: ATN Info (UAE B2B directory)
notes: Strong for industrial and garage equipment visibility in UAE.

name: Kompass UAE
notes: B2B directory; useful if you supply or service workshops at scale.

name: UAE Business Directory
notes: Free basic listing; keep NAP identical to your website.

name: Gulf Business Directory
notes: Submit company profile with Sharjah/Ajman service areas.

name: Ajman Chamber of Commerce
notes: If you are a chamber member, ensure your listing includes website and phone.

name: Sharjah Chamber of Commerce
notes: Check member services portal for business directory visibility.

name: Yelp (UAE)
notes: Claim or add your business; fewer users than Google in UAE but still a citation.
